nodes.label: MVC Architecture
nodes.rationale: Chosen to separate business logic (controllers), data layer (models/schemas), and routing so the Node.js/Express/MongoDB backend stays maintainable and organized by responsibility.

nodes.label: Order Collection (Day 1)
nodes.rationale: Retailers place orders via Retailer App, WhatsApp, phone, or sales executives; all orders enter the ERP before a cut-off time so the Warehouse Head can plan routes with full visibility of demand.

nodes.label: Warehouse Route Planning
nodes.rationale: A minimum of 10 retailers are assigned per vehicle and routes are optimized and assigned to drivers the previous night, to maximize vehicle capacity utilization and prepare drivers in advance.

nodes.label: Driver Login & Authentication
nodes.rationale: Uses Mobile OTP login and surfaces assigned vehicle details, assigned route, and day-wise orders so drivers start each day with a verified identity and a pre-planned route.

nodes.label: Loading Verification
nodes.rationale: Driver verifies fish stock, ice, crates, and packaging materials before dispatch, with warehouse supervisor confirmation, to prevent incomplete or incorrect loads leaving the warehouse.

nodes.label: Delivery Process
nodes.rationale: Driver records GPS and arrival time at each retailer location before delivering products, enabling location-verified delivery tracking.

nodes.label: Delivery Confirmation
nodes.rationale: Confirmed via OTP or digital signature so ERP, inventory, and retailer systems can update automatically without manual reconciliation.

nodes.label: Payment Collection
nodes.rationale: Supports cash, UPI, and bank transfer with driver-uploaded proof, so accounts update instantly and cash collection is improved.

nodes.label: Damage & Return Management
nodes.rationale: Captures return reason, photos, and quantity, classifying returns as replacement, credit note, or warehouse return to standardize how damaged/returned seafood is handled.

nodes.label: Return Material Collection
nodes.rationale: Tracks fish crates, ice boxes, thermocol boxes, and other returnable assets so reusable cold-chain equipment is not lost.

nodes.label: Live Route Monitoring
nodes.rationale: Warehouse team monitors route completion, vehicle location, delays, and route deviations in real time to catch problems before they affect delivery SLAs.

nodes.label: Cold Chain Monitoring
nodes.rationale: Records loading time, dispatch time, delivery time, and total transit duration to ensure cold-chain compliance for perishable seafood/fish products.

nodes.label: Warehouse Return Process
nodes.rationale: Driver returns with collected materials and returned products for reconciliation, closing the loop on assets and unsold/returned stock.

nodes.label: ERP Integration Flow
nodes.rationale: Defines the end-to-end system chain: Retailer Order -> ERP -> Route Planning -> Invoice Generation -> Driver Assignment -> Delivery Tracking -> Payment Collection -> Returns -> Warehouse Reconciliation -> Daily Reports, tying every workflow stage to a single automated pipeline.

nodes.label: Strategic Benefits
nodes.rationale: The overall system is designed to reduce delivery leakage, improve cold-chain compliance, track returnable assets, improve cash collection, and give end-to-end seafood supply chain visibility.
